items.summary: Self-hosted Go newsletter and mailing-list manager with a single binary, PostgreSQL and an API.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building subscriber lists, campaign sending and unsubscribe handling for newsletters.
cautions: Needs an SMTP relay with good deliverability.
Comply with consent and unsubscribe laws in your markets.
install: Self-host from the official container image or release; pin the image tag and review the upgrade notes before each upgrade.

items.name: Postal

license.scope: MIT for the upstream code.

items.summary: Self-hosted mail delivery platform for sending and receiving transactional email with webhooks and tracking.
items.useWhen: Use instead of running raw Postfix plus custom tracking when you must self-host outbound transactional email.
cautions: Deliverability (IP reputation, rDNS, SPF/DKIM) is your responsibility.
install: Self-host from the official container image or release; pin the image tag and review the upgrade notes before each upgrade.

items.name: web-push

license.scope: MPL-2.0 for the upstream code.

items.summary: Node.js library for sending Web Push Protocol messages with VAPID and payload encryption.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-implementing VAPID JWTs and aes128gcm payload encryption for browser push notifications.
cautions: Releases are infrequent but the protocol is stable.
Remove subscriptions that return 404/410.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: ntfy

license.scope: Dual-licensed Apache-2.0 or GPL-2.0; choose Apache-2.0.

items.summary: Simple HTTP pub-sub push notification service with phone apps; send alerts with a single POST.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building a push channel for ops alerts or personal notifications to phones and desktops.
cautions: Public ntfy.sh topics are guessable; use access control or self-host for private alerts.
install: Self-host from the official container image or release; pin the image tag and review the upgrade notes before each upgrade.

items.name: OpenFeature JavaScript SDK

license.scope: Apache-2.0 for the upstream code.

items.summary: CNCF vendor-neutral feature-flag evaluation API for JavaScript with providers for most flag backends.
items.useWhen: Use instead of coupling code to one flag vendor's SDK; swap providers (Unleash, Flagsmith, GrowthBook, LaunchDarkly) without code changes.
cautions: You still need a provider package and a flag backend.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: OpenFeature Python SDK

license.scope: Apache-2.0 for the upstream code.

items.summary: Vendor-neutral OpenFeature evaluation API for Python services.
items.useWhen: Use instead of binding Python code to a single flag vendor's client.

install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.summary: Vendor-neutral OpenFeature evaluation API for Go services.
items.useWhen: Use instead of binding Go services to a single flag vendor's client.

items.name: Payload

items.summary: TypeScript headless CMS and app framework that installs into a Next.js app with auth, access control and admin UI.

items.name: Strapi

items.useWhen: Use instead of building content models, editorial admin and content APIs from scratch.
cautions: Avoid ee/ features without a license.
Major upgrades (v4 to v5) need migration.
